title: Huna Mar son of Rava of Parzika
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Ketubot 10a, where he posed a difficulty to Rav Ashi. Perhaps he is R"H son of Rava.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The identification with Rav Huna son of Rava is Hyman’s tentative suggestion.

The actual Davidson Ketubot 10a paragraph names untitled Huna Mar son of Rava of Parzikya addressing Rav Ashi. The supplied Parzika spelling is retained. Hyman’s “perhaps” identification remains a conjecture; the new body retains R"H without expanding that separate abbreviated occurrence. The existing note is unchanged and is not fresh evidence for a Rav Huna title or an identity.
